title: Your link and QR code
summary: Shows the user's profile link (bipe.chat/@handle) and its QR code, to share or to show in person. Whoever opens it lands on the user in Bipe.

handle.description: From GET /v1/me/handle. Without it: bipe_public_profile_needs_handle and bipe_handle_prompt_action.

publicProfileOn.description: MyProfile.enabled. Changes what the link shows on the web (see notes), not what it does in the app.

showingQr.description: true: the QR code with bipe_profile_qr_title and bipe_profile_qr_footer.

share.effect: The system share sheet with the link.

copy.effect: Copies the link and shows bipe_app_copied.

toggleQr.effect: Shows or hides the QR code.

notes: The link is the @ on the bipe.chat host: https://bipe.chat/@<handle>. Bipe logic: BipeProfileLink.url and handle(from:) (BipeKit BipeProfileLink.swift); BipeLinks.kt (libraries/bipe). The rule is used by both apps and the site, so it belongs in registries/ (ADR 0031); until it moves, the two Bipe implementations are the reference.
On the web, the link shows the public profile when it is on, else a page that opens the app or the store. In the app it always opens profile-link-open.
The QR code holds exactly the link. Drawn on the device with the same permissive encoder as invite-qr, dark on light in both themes.
Opens from Seu perfil (settings-group profile, handle row) and from public-profile-edit.
